description:
modules/timetable — GET /api/timetable/offering-gaps (#5343) when a
booking carries a pickup time and its class a Klassentag: the reads of
api.timetable.offering_gaps for Klasse Regeltermine (whose template list
also reads their targets and target members), plus the class arrival
plans and changes and one batch of rosters (enrollment rows, targets,
target members). Care Plan's bookings are stubbed (budgeted under
services.enrollment.*). Flat from 3 to 8 Regeltermine.
